messages:
maria: Heads-up: we're deprecating legacy code snippets and all `sdk.v1` examples in the public docs. Migration window: 6 weeks. Target removal date: 2026-05-15. See plan below.
mike: Quick q — will this cause runtime breakages for existing customers if they keep using old examples?
jess: No forced runtime break. This is docs/code-level deprecation only. But we’re renaming param `model` -> `model_id` in the new SDK; old call still supported for 2 months but will warn.
elaine: I'll own the doc edits. Can someone drop a migration diff for code blocks? :raising_hand:
tom: Pushed a draft to the repo: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/migrations/snippets-v2 — highlights:

```
# OLD
client.complete(model="redwood-alpha", prompt="hi")

# NEW
client.complete(model_id="redwood-alpha", input="hi")
```

mike: Thanks — will we add a compatibility shim in SDK so old param names still work with warning logs?
jess: Yes: SDK v2.1 includes a shim that maps `model` -> `model_id` and emits a one-time warning. Planning to remove shim in v3.0.
maria: Timeline recap: - Today: announce to internal teams - 1 week: docs teams to submit PRs for snippet updates - 3 weeks: staged publish behind feature flag - 6 weeks (2026-05-15): legacy snippets removed and docs redirect in place.
elaine: I'll create a tracking spreadsheet and assign sections. ping me if you want ownership. I'll also add a note in the migration guide for embeddings, reranking, and function-calling examples.
docs-bot: Automated check: docs PR template updated, snippet-lint CI rule will run on changed files. :robot_face:
mike: Can we auto-run snippet-lint for all docs to find hidden old patterns?
tom: Already scheduled a run tonight; results will be in the PR: https://ci.redwood/run/1234
jess: tiny nit: update the Quickstart's code sample and the interactive playground to use `model_id`. Those are high-traffic, priority 1.
maria: Good call. @elaine please prioritize quickstart + playground. After PRs merge, we'll send a public SDK deprecation note with migration snippets and a compatibility table.
elaine: On it. I'll draft the public note and share for review by EOD tomorrow.
mike: Any customer-facing risk? legal/compliance note?
maria: No PII risk. Support and AE teams are being looped in; we've prepared a canned FAQ and migration commands.
jess: small follow-up: update internal sample repos too (templates/ and examples/). I'll open PRs after shim lands.

maria: Thanks everyone — if you hit blocker raise in #release-war-room. :thumbsup:
